description: This source file implements a command-line tool for generating transport security state data, including parsing input files, performing validation checks, and generating output using a preloaded state generator.

classes.name: PreloadedStateGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating the preloaded transport security state data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading input files, validation, generating output, and writing the result.

methods.name: CheckForDuplicatePins
methods.description: Checks for duplicate pin names or hashes in the provided pinsets.

methods.name: CheckCertificatesInPinsets
methods.description: Validates that pinsets reference existing pins, do not have duplicate names, and all pins are used.

methods.name: CheckDuplicateEntries
methods.description: Detects duplicate hostname entries in the security state entries.

methods.name: CheckNoopEntries
methods.description: Checks for entries that have no effect (neither force HTTPS nor pins).

methods.name: CheckHostnames
methods.description: Validates that hostnames are in canonicalized form and properly formatted.

methods.name: IsLowercaseAlphanumeric
methods.description: Helper function to check if a character is a lowercase letter or digit.
